g.text: AI voice companion for older adults · daily check-ins, gentle reminders, and family peace of mind
What it does · When it runs · How it flows · Where people touch it · Which problems it solves
1 · HOW IT WORKS — the daily check-in flow
Runs once a day at the senior's regular time (WHEN). No app, no hardware — it works on any phone.
A warm AI call at the
↻ The loop repeats every day — dependable routine in the background, surfacing only what matters.
2 · THE OPERATING MODEL — AI + System + Human
AI begins the interaction, the system keeps it organised and reliable, and a person steps in when judgment is needed.
• Gets alerts to the right person
Goal: make care easier to carry — automate the repetitive, organise what matters, keep humans in charge of the human part.
Each family pain on the left → how Kinviva answers it on the right.
1 in 4 older adults face chronic loneliness — a health
risk likened to smoking 15 cigarettes a day.
A real, caring conversation every day so seniors stay
connected — with dignity, never talked down to.
~50% of older adults miss medications; forgotten
Clear prompts at the right moment for meds, appointments
and important tasks — simple and respectful.
“Did Mom take her meds? Is Dad okay?” Constant,
exhausting worry for working adult children.
Simple, jargon-free notifications + a portal. Know all is
well — or get told the moment it isn't.
In-home care and monitoring are expensive; many
families are priced out and left unsupported.
Works on the phone they already own. No app, no devices
— accessible support without the heavy cost.
Two people, one platform. Each side meets Kinviva where they already are.
Answers a normal phone call — no app
⚠ Scope: Kinviva is a supportive companion service — not a medical, healthcare or emergency service.
